<h1><center>Recognition of human actions</center></h1>


<FONT SIZE=+2>Action Database</FONT> <br>
<ul>
The current video database containing six
types of human actions (walking, jogging, running, boxing,
hand waving and hand clapping) performed several times by 25 subjects in
four different scenarios: outdoors <i>s1</i>, outdoors with scale variation <i>s2</i>,
outdoors with different clothes <i>s3</i> and indoors <i>s4</i> as illustrated below.
Currently the database contains 2391 sequences.
All sequences were taken over homogeneous backgrounds with a static camera
with <i>25</i>fps frame rate.
The sequences were downsampled to the spatial resolution of <i>160x120</i> pixels 
and have a length of four seconds in average.

<p>
In our experiments reported in
<a href="http://www.csc.kth.se/~laptev/abstracts/icpr04actions.html">ICPR'04</a>
<a href="http://www.csc.kth.se/~laptev/abstracts/icpr04actions.html">ICPR'04</a>
all sequences were divided with respect to the subjects into a training set
(8 persons), a validation set (8 persons) and a test set (9 persons).
The classifiers were trained on a training set while the validation set was used
to optimize the parameters of each method.
The recognition results were obtained on the test set.
</ul>

<p><center><img SRC="http://www.csc.kth.se/cvap/actions/actions.gif" align=TOP></center>
<p><center><img SRC="http://www.csc.kth.se/cvap/actions/actions.gif" align=TOP></center>

<p>
<ul>
All sequences are stored using AVI file format and are available on-line (DIVX-compressed version).
Uncompressed version is available on demand.
There are <i>25x6x4=600</i> video files for each combination of 25 subjects, 6 actions and 4 scenarios.
Each file contains about four subsequences used as a <i>sequence</i> in our experiments.
The subdivision of each file into sequences in terms <i>start_frame</i> and <i>end_frame</i>
as well as the list of all sequences is given in 
<p>
<ul>
<a HREF=http://www.csc.kth.se/cvap/actions/00sequences.txt> 00sequences.txt</a>
<a HREF=http://www.csc.kth.se/cvap/actions/00sequences.txt> 00sequences.txt</a>
</ul>
<br><p>

<b>Action database in zip-archives (DivX-compressed)</b><br>
Note: The database is publicly available for non-commercial use.
Please refer to 
<a href="http://www.csc.kth.se/~laptev/abstracts/icpr04actions.html">
<a href="http://www.csc.kth.se/~laptev/abstracts/icpr04actions.html">
[Schuldt, Laptev and Caputo, <i> Proc. ICPR'04, Cambridge, UK </i>]</a>
if you use this database in your publications.
